name: setup
js: (() => { document.getElementById('setupDialog').close(); const s0 = GMMC.getSettings(); s0.lang = 'en'; s0.mapStyle = 'material'; GMMC.saveSettings(); GMMC.applyI18n(); window.__dl = []; GMMC.download = (n, b) => { window.__dl.push({ n, b }); }; window.__toasts = []; const tt = GMMC.toast; GMMC.toast = (m) => { window.__toasts.push(m); }; GMMC.setLayout('schematic'); GMMC.fit(); return { layout: GMMC.getSettings().layout, style: GMMC.getSettings().mapStyle, cards: document.querySelectorAll('#mapStyleSec .ms-card').length, settingsCards: document.querySelectorAll('#msSettings .ms-card').length, menuItem: !!document.getElementById('printMenuBtn') }; })()

name: pick-classic
js: (() => { document.querySelector('#mapStyleSec .ms-card[data-ms="classic"]').click(); const svg = document.getElementById('viewport').innerHTML; return { style: GMMC.getSettings().mapStyle, stageAttr: document.getElementById('stage').dataset.mapstyle, pressed: [...document.querySelectorAll('#mapStyleSec .ms-card')].map(b => b.getAttribute('aria-pressed')).join(','), squareCaps: (svg.match(/stroke-linecap="square"/g) || []).length, ticks: (svg.match(/<line [^>]*stroke-linecap="butt"/g) || []).length, upperLabel: (svg.match(/<text class="st-label"[^>]*>[^<a-z]*<\/text>/g) || []).length, widths: [...new Set([...svg.matchAll(/stroke-width="(\d+)"/g)].map(m => m[1]))].join(','), stored: JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('gmmc.settings.v1')).mapStyle, projectHas: JSON.parse(GMMC.projectJson()).settings.mapStyle }; })()

name: pick-frequent
js: (() => { document.querySelector('#mapStyleSec .ms-card[data-ms="frequent"]').click(); const svg = document.getElementById('viewport').innerHTML; return { style: GMMC.getSettings().mapStyle, stageAttr: document.getElementById('stage').dataset.mapstyle, pressed: [...document.querySelectorAll('#mapStyleSec .ms-card')].map(b => b.getAttribute('aria-pressed')).join(','), squareCaps: (svg.match(/stroke-linecap="square"/g) || []).length, ticks: (svg.match(/<line [^>]*stroke-linecap="butt"/g) || []).length, upperLabel: (svg.match(/<text class="st-label"[^>]*>[^<a-z]*<\/text>/g) || []).length, widths: [...new Set([...svg.matchAll(/stroke-width="(\d+)"/g)].map(m => m[1]))].join(','), stored: JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('gmmc.settings.v1')).mapStyle, projectHas: JSON.parse(GMMC.projectJson()).settings.mapStyle }; })()

name: pick-night
js: (() => { document.querySelector('#mapStyleSec .ms-card[data-ms="night"]').click(); const svg = document.getElementById('viewport').innerHTML; return { style: GMMC.getSettings().mapStyle, stageAttr: document.getElementById('stage').dataset.mapstyle, pressed: [...document.querySelectorAll('#mapStyleSec .ms-card')].map(b => b.getAttribute('aria-pressed')).join(','), squareCaps: (svg.match(/stroke-linecap="square"/g) || []).length, ticks: (svg.match(/<line [^>]*stroke-linecap="butt"/g) || []).length, upperLabel: (svg.match(/<text class="st-label"[^>]*>[^<a-z]*<\/text>/g) || []).length, widths: [...new Set([...svg.matchAll(/stroke-width="(\d+)"/g)].map(m => m[1]))].join(','), stored: JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('gmmc.settings.v1')).mapStyle, projectHas: JSON.parse(GMMC.projectJson()).settings.mapStyle }; })()

name: settingsCards
js: (() => { document.getElementById('settingsBtn').click(); const r = { visible: document.querySelector('#msSettings .ms-card').getBoundingClientRect().width > 0, pressed: document.querySelector('#msSettings .ms-card[aria-pressed=true]').dataset.ms }; return r; })()

name: openPrint
js: (() => { document.getElementById('exportBtn').click(); document.getElementById('printMenuBtn').click(); const d = document.getElementById('printDialog'); const set = (id, v) => { const e = document.getElementById(id); e.value = v; e.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); }; set('prPaper', 'A3'); set('prTitleIn', 'GTHA Rapid Transit'); set('prSub', 'Frequent service, 2031 plan'); document.querySelector('#prOrient [data-o=landscape]').click(); return { open: d.open, paper: document.getElementById('prPaper').value, options: document.getElementById('prPaper').options.length }; })()

name: previewInfo
js: (() => { const b = document.getElementById('prPrev'); return { w: b.style.width, h: b.style.height, hasSvg: !!b.querySelector('svg'), texts: b.querySelectorAll('text').length }; })()

name: exportA3
js: (async () => { document.getElementById('prExport').click(); for (let i = 0; i < 80 && !window.__dl.length; i++) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); const d = window.__dl[window.__dl.length - 1]; if (!d) return { error: 'no download', toasts: window.__toasts }; const buf = new Uint8Array(await d.b.arrayBuffer()); const txt = new TextDecoder('latin1').decode(buf); const mb = /MediaBox\s*\[([^\]]*)\]/.exec(txt); let ops = ''; let p = 0; while ((p = txt.indexOf('stream', p)) >= 0) { if (txt.slice(p - 3, p) === 'end') { p += 6; continue; } let st = p + 6; if (txt[st] === '\r') st++; if (txt[st] === '\n') st++; const end = txt.indexOf('endstream', st); const slice = buf.slice(st, end - 1); p = end + 9; try { const ds = new Blob([slice]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream('deflate')); ops += await new Response(ds).text(); } catch (e) { } } const names = Object.values(GMMC.getMap().stations).slice(0, 40).map(s => s.name); const found = names.filter(n => ops.includes('(' + n + ')')); window.__ops = ops; return { name: d.n, size: buf.length, head: txt.slice(0, 8), mediaBox: mb && mb[1], BT: (ops.match(/\bBT\b/g) || []).length, Tj: (ops.match(/\bTj\b/g) || []).length, imageDo: (ops.match(/\bDo\b/g) || []).length, namesFound: found.length + '/' + names.length, sample: found.slice(0, 4), type: d.b.type, toasts: window.__toasts }; })()

name: nightPdf
js: (async () => { document.querySelector('#mapStyleSec .ms-card[data-ms="night"]').click(); window.__dl.length = 0; const r = await GMMCPrint.makePdf(); return { name: r.name, size: r.blob && r.blob.size, fallback: !!r.fallback }; })()

name: portraitA4
js: (async () => { document.querySelector('#mapStyleSec .ms-card[data-ms="classic"]').click(); GMMCPrint.setOptions({ paper: 'A4', landscape: false, legend: 'tr' }); const r = await GMMCPrint.makePdf(); const t = new TextDecoder('latin1').decode(new Uint8Array(await r.blob.arrayBuffer())); return { box: /MediaBox\s*\[([^\]]*)\]/.exec(t)[1], size: r.blob.size }; })()

name: cantonese
js: (async () => { GMMCPrint.setOptions({ paper: 'A3', landscape: true, legend: 'br' }); const s = GMMC.getSettings(); s.lang = 'yue'; GMMC.saveSettings(); GMMC.applyI18n(); window.__calls = []; const o = GMMC.exportAct; GMMC.exportAct = (a) => { window.__calls.push(a); }; const r = await GMMCPrint.makePdf(); GMMC.exportAct = o; return { fallback: !!r.fallback, hasBlob: !!r.blob }; })()

name: exportYue
js: (async () => { const calls = []; const o = GMMC.exportAct; GMMC.exportAct = (a) => { calls.push(a); }; document.getElementById('prExport').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2500)); GMMC.exportAct = o; return { calls, toasts: window.__toasts.slice(-2) }; })()
